text_001: Wilfrido Ortega a nase, 26 Oktober 1932 i a fayese 26 Mei 2026 ku 93 aña. El a dediká su mes na skibi i publiká buki na Papiamentu. Su produktivida, su ingenuidat pa publiká i distribuí su bukinan di porta pa porta ta e temanan ku e wèpsait aki ta eksplorá.
text_004: Su komienso na 1958, títulonan konmemorativo, aksesibilidat i rekonosementu.

text_015: Wilfrido Ortega was born on 26 October 1932 and died on 26 May 2026 at the age of 93. He devoted himself to writing and publishing books in Papiamentu. This website explores his literary output, his ingenuity in publishing, and how he personally distributed his books door to door.

text_025: The first manuscript of Destino di Amor contained 500 pages. On the recommendation of Otto Zalm of Editorial Tim Americana, Wilfrido reduced it to sixty pages to lower printing costs.
